cells.claim: Pure provisioning and PAIR-layout logic is deterministic; depth contracts are added red-first
The built CLI and fragmented local HTTP boundaries cover bounded acquisition, timeout, truncation, response variants, stream cleanup, envelope parsing, and bounded QuickLZ decoding
Tracked Rust sources are formatted and warning-free
Pinned native Cargo resolution denies crates.io versions younger than seven days and the complete lockfile passes an independent age audit

cells.environment: Ubuntu 24.04 with pinned Rust mutation tool
cells.claim: Existing depth-stream, envelope, decoder, calibration, and ROS mapping mutation sets remain covered; the new PAIR decoder, emitter fail-closed paths, stereo matcher/disparity encoder, spatial consensus/median filter, map/Q parser/full reprojection, metric Z16/PGM, and robust depth-statistics focused sets catch all viable mutants exercised. Rectification, HTTP, and ROS runtime-adapter mutation gaps remain open

Real-hardware runs configured selector 1 PAIR output, enabled and settled the infrared projector, captured exactly 1048576 live bytes, disabled illumination, closed the stream, and restarted without power cycling

The Rust client recovered and QuickLZ-decompressed complete bounded envelopes; each 512000-byte frame splits into contiguous 640x400 left and right Y8 planes, and the emitted PGM images visibly contain the physical target

cells.environment: POP 3 Plus and measured physical targets
cells.claim: Clean-room rectification, bounded SAD disparity, uniqueness, left/right consistency, spatial consensus/median filtering, and Q reprojection run end-to-end; a live wall capture retained 14.7% of pixels with median 263 mm, MAD 9 mm, and p10-p90 234-272 mm, which quantifies rather than clears the planar failure

Offline runtime message construction passes; corrected live publication delivered 20 reconstructed frames and a subscriber observed a 640-wide 32FC1 image, but the reconstructed metric plane remains unqualified

cells.command: ros2 run depth_image_proc point_cloud_xyz_node --ros-args -r image_rect:=/depth/image_rect -r camera_info:=/depth/camera_info
cells.claim: Stock depth_image_proc emitted a 640-wide organized PointCloud2 from corrected reconstructed depth and RViz2 displayed it; the wall appeared as sparse separated lobes, so visual plane geometry and measured-target accuracy remain unaccepted

cells.environment: POP 3 Plus, turntable, ROS 2 Jazzy, RViz2
cells.claim: RViz2 displayed the corrected live reconstructed depth image and point cloud with a static optical-frame transform; the sparse separated cloud failed the planar-wall geometry check and measured-target acceptance remains open
